availability_evidence.note: The captured PDF carries the PREB docket receipt stamp 'NEPR Received: Jun 20, 2025 9:12 PM' (Puerto Rico time, UTC-4). Earliest Wayback snapshot is 2025-06-27T22:18:45Z; server Last-Modified is 24 Jun 2025 12:33:29 GMT. NOTE: the RFP itself was issued Mar 25, 2025, EARLIER than this observed_at; the RFP document and the 3PPO issue notice were not captured, so this timestamp is the first captured public evidence of the procurement, not the procurement's own start, and it makes any lead time measured to it LONGER than to the RFP issuance.

target.source_quote:
On March 25, 2025, the 3PPO issued RFP No. 3PPO-0314-20-TPG for the
procurement of up to 800 MW of temporary emergency generation capacity. The objective of the RFP was to identify one or more qualified providers capable of deploying and operating generation solutions—such as barges or mobile gas turbines—at the Aguirre and Costa Sur substations. The 3PPO received and evaluated seven proposals, which resulted in the selection of one proponent.
target.target_description: Competitive 3PPO procurement (RFP issued Mar 25, 2025) for up to 800 MW of temporary emergency generation (barges or mobile gas turbines at Aguirre and Costa Sur), as reported in PREPA's Jun 20, 2025 motion submitting the proposed contract to PREB; the RFP is the earliest procurement-type event found, and the motion is the first captured public evidence of it.

lead_time.note: UNVERIFIED: the earliest signal (s1, Feb 26 2025) is PRINTED_DATE_ONLY. Neither order was captured and the conflict is unresolved; no date is asserted here.
